name: Green River (Desolation & Gray Canyons)
gaugeName: Green River at Green River, UT
blurb: Remote Desolation and Gray canyons below Sand Wash, plus the popular no-permit Green River Daily through lower Gray Canyon.

sections.notes: BLM permit required year-round. ~60 named Class II-III rapids; Joe Hutch Rapid can elevate to Class IV-V- at high water. East (river left) bank in Desolation is Uintah & Ouray Reservation - tribal permit needed to camp/hike there.
Green River Daily: BLM - family friendly, Class I and II rapids, no permit required. BLM Nefertiti page says 8 river miles; WSR page 8.5.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
